name: RG20261
tagline: Compact cast iron power for cozy interior warmth
description: The Northern Flame Logi is a compact yet highly effective closed-combustion fireplace crafted from premium Australian mineral iron ore. Its classic ribbed cast iron body is designed for maximum heat retention and radiation, continuing to warm your space long after the fire has dimmed. With its airtight door gaskets and precision-controlled air vents, the Logi offers an excellent overnight burn system, making it an ideal heating solution for smaller rooms, cabins, or studios.
features: Durable full cast iron construction for superior heat radiation
Air-wash system to keep the ceramic glass viewing window clear
Primary and secondary air controls for optimized combustion
Removable ash pan and grate for effortless cleaning
Compact footprint with high-temperature resistant finish
